_comment: #2216: typed wishes the Apprentice must answer with the Builder's 'Turn things into…' power, in the many ways a child says it. Each row names what the TOP tile must be: from = the From page's groups (any order), to = the To page's pick. A row with expect.power != turn_into is a CONTROL: the words look similar and must NOT become a turn-into wand. Owner-written test wishes, never training examples (docs/APPRENTICE.md: test clauses are never added to the layer's examples). Group ids: from = any_block, ores, logs, sand, stone, dirt_grass, gravel, clay, raw_food, plants, wool, netherrack, ice_snow; to = furnace, gold, iron, copper, diamond, emerald, coal, glass, stone, cobblestone, sand, dirt, gravel, wool, planks, ice, vanish (wool since #2236).
